text:
jordan: Quick heads-up — ARB meeting Wed 10:00 PT. Trying a rotating chair for Q2 so each meeting has a facilitator who owns the agenda + notes. Proposed rotation and agenda below. Please reply with conflicts or swap requests.

jordan: Proposed rotation (weekly):
- 2026-03-25: marta
- 2026-04-01: sam
- 2026-04-08: leo
- 2026-04-15: jordan
- 2026-04-22: kai

jordan: Agenda template (30m):
1) 5m quick wins / status updates
2) 15m RFC / design review (pre-read required; facilitator triages slides + decision points)
3) 5m platform-standards checks (lint rules, infra changes)
4) 5m ops / triage + action items

marta: I can take 3/25. Can we ensure RFCs are linked in the calendar invite? :thumbsup:

sam: I'll take 4/1. Suggest making the RFC slot 20m when the design is heavy — we can flex on a per-meeting basis.

leo: +1 to flexing. Also propose a standing 5m "blocker" slot after the meeting for immediate follow-ups (quick sync).

kai: Heads up — I have a customer privacy RFC that might need 4/8. I'll add pre-reads if it's approved by next week.

jordan: calendar-bot: created invite https://calendar.example.com/event/ARB-Weekly?eid=abc123 — added agenda and placeholder for pre-reads. Please add links to the doc or RFC PR.

sam: small ask — can we standardize "DECISION:" tags in notes for follow-ups, e.g., use uppercase prefix so it's searchable?

marta: agreed. I'll add a notes template to the shared doc with fields: Facilitator, Attendees, Pre-reads, Agenda, Notes, DECISIONS, ACTIONS.

leo: :hand: I can take notes 4/8 if that helps.

jordan: Thanks — I'll update the rotation doc and the calendar event. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll lock the schedule and ping the wider arch team.

arb-bot: Reminder set — next ARB meeting Wed 10:00 PT. Facilitator: marta.
